# html2xtc

> Public HTTP API that converts a URL, an uploaded PDF, a plain-text file, or
> an EPUB into an XTC file for the Xteink X3 e-reader. The conversion
> endpoints require no authentication and no API key. They are rate-limited
> per client IP (see api.md). Everything else on this domain (library sync,
> device pairing, OPDS) requires a logged-in session and is out of scope for
> unauthenticated agents — do not call `/api/library/*`, `/api/devices/*`,
> `/opds/*`, or `/internal/*`; they will return 401.

Full reference: [api.md](https://xtc.hr20k.com/api.md). Machine-readable
schema: [openapi.json](https://xtc.hr20k.com/openapi.json). Human WebUI and
usage policy: [about](https://xtc.hr20k.com/about).

## Quick start

Submit a conversion job, poll until it completes, then download the XTC file.
`POST /jobs` is asynchronous and is the recommended entry point (`POST
/convert` is synchronous, times out around 150 seconds, and is only suitable
for short pages).

```sh
# 1. Create a job; abort if jobId didn't come back (400/429/503/500 body has
# no jobId field, so job_id ends up empty)
job=$(curl -s --max-time 15 -X POST https://xtc.hr20k.com/jobs \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"url": "https://example.com/article", "mode": "extract"}')
job_id=$(echo "$job" | sed -n 's/.*"jobId":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')
[ -n "$job_id" ] || { echo "job creation failed: $job" >&2; exit 1; }

# 2. Poll every few seconds until status is "completed" or "failed" (bounded
# attempts, so a stuck job or network trouble can't loop forever)
status=queued
for _ in $(seq 1 150); do
  status=$(curl -s --max-time 15 "https://xtc.hr20k.com/jobs/$job_id" | sed -n 's/.*"status":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')
  { [ "$status" = completed ] || [ "$status" = failed ]; } && break
  sleep 4
done

# 3. Download the XTC file only if the job actually completed
[ "$status" = completed ] || { echo "job did not complete (status: $status)" >&2; exit 1; }
curl -s --max-time 15 -o output.xtc "https://xtc.hr20k.com/jobs/$job_id/download"
```

## Docs

- [API reference (api.md)](https://xtc.hr20k.com/api.md): job lifecycle,
  upload endpoints (PDF/TXT/EPUB), request/response shapes, status codes,
  rate limits, and size limits for the unauthenticated conversion API.
- [OpenAPI 3.1 schema (openapi.json)](https://xtc.hr20k.com/openapi.json):
  machine-readable definitions of the same endpoints.

## Notes for agents

- Default to `POST /jobs` (async) over `POST /convert` (sync, short-page
  only). Poll `GET /jobs/{jobId}` every 4-5 seconds; it is not rate-limited.
- The conversion-starting endpoints (`POST /convert`, `/jobs`, `/jobs/pdf`,
  `/jobs/text`, `/jobs/epub`) share one IP-based rate limit budget (default
  50 requests/hour). A 429 response includes `Retry-After` in seconds — wait
  that long before retrying, don't busy-loop.
- When fetching a target page yourself (rather than passing a URL to this
  service), note that this service's own Browser Rendering step identifies
  itself as `xtc-converter/1.0 (+https://xtc.hr20k.com/about)`; site owners
  may block or allow that user agent independently of yours.
